messages:
ava: dropping a short thread with a couple focused questions for the latency card on narrow dashboards. main goals: keep p95 readable, make heatmap keyboard-first, and simplify sampling controls.
rui: thanks. list out the decisions you want?
ava: 1) legend density: inline percentiles vs separate lines? 2) sampling control: preset dropdown vs slider + presets? 3) heatmap a11y for canvas paint. 4) pin vs sync range behavior.
jamal: quick backend notes: slider min at 1% to prevent accidental ultra-low queries. we can expose org default sample via prefs. also baseline endpoint is cheap to add: /api/baselines?metric=latency&compare=prev.
lisa: a11y: if canvas is kept, mirror DOM grid for assistive tech. role="grid" + cells role="gridcell". aria-label for cells should be concise: "Bucket 3 of 8: 78 requests, p95 214 ms". Debounce SR announcements until user pauses (300ms).
theo: discoverability concern: compact legend that hides percentile labels at small widths is fine if hover/focus reveals them. for keyboard users, ensure a visible affordance to expand legend.
ava: proposal: legend header "Latency (ms)" and inline tags "p50  p95" when space allows; collapse to just header + chevron on narrow. bucket labels abbreviate "<50" and tooltip always has units.
rui: sampling: dropdown presets (1%,5%,10%) plus a "custom" entry that expands to a slider for fine tuning. show effective source: "Data sample: 5% (org default)" when applicable. change UI label from "sample rate" to "Data sample" per support feedback.
jamal: API param remains sample_rate; client maps UI term to param. note: default heatmap sample of 5% recommended for large queries.
lisa: keyboard shortcuts: T = open timepicker, Shift+T = toggle pin for focused card, S = sampling presets. expose ? for help overlay. shortcuts should be remappable in prefs.
theo: pin behavior: suggest default per-panel per-user pin. add a separate "Sync ranges across dashboard" toggle at top of page for session-level sync, not persisted unless user saves. visual: small filled pin + dashed card outline when pinned; tooltip "Pinned range (you)".
ava: aria notes for pin: have an aria-live polite region that says "Time range pinned for this panel" and button aria-label="Unpin time range for panel" with 44px min hit target.
lisa: scrubber aria snippet suggestion:
```
role=\"slider\" aria-valuemin=\"0\" aria-valuemax=\"100\" aria-valuenow=\"45\" aria-label=\"Time range start\" aria-live=\"polite\"
```
but keep live messages short. debounce live updates to 200-300ms to avoid SR noise.
ava: perf + a11y: lazy-mount DOM mirror only when keyboard navigation or screen reader detected to avoid canvas perf hit. if mirror mounts, keep it visually hidden (opacity:0, position:absolute) but focusable.
jamal: implementation caveat: mirror mounting adds ~80-120ms on very large panels; acceptable if conditional.
rui: reduced-motion: respect prefers-reduced-motion OR a user pref. if set, disable smooth scrubbing transitions. add a user-pref flag via prefs endpoint.
theo: color/accessibility: add hatch pattern or angled lines option for top density bucket in colorblind mode. also ensure contrast of focus halo meets AA.
ava: microcopy: tooltip short -> "p95: 214 ms"; keyboard focus/readout -> "95th percentile latency: 214 milliseconds". legend -> "Latency (ms)"; sampling label -> "Data sample".
design-bot: Ava uploaded updated Figma frames -> https://redwood.app/figma/strip-legend-compact-heatmap.
ava: thanks all. i'll update the figma and a11y checklist and post a brief spec with the aria snippets. sync tomorrow 9:30am to review implementation tasks.
